Calvin Klein My Euphoria Eau de Parfum 10ml Miniature is a sensual and modern women’s fragrance with sweet fruity, floral and warm gourmand accords. Juicy blackcurrant and delicate florals blend with rich vanilla and amber for a smooth, feminine scent in a convenient travel-friendly size.

  • Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper
  • Heart Notes: Orchid, Rose, Jasmine
  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Woods

Barcode: 3616304478284

Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 10ml is a bold and modern men’s fragrance with aromatic, leathery and woody accords. Grapefruit and hemp open into spicy black pepper and geranium, while leather and vetiver create a deep, masculine and long-lasting finish in a compact travel size.

  • Top Notes: Grapefruit, Hemp
  • Heart Notes: Black Pepper, Geranium
  • Base Notes: Leather, Vetiver

Barcode: 8411061035849

Discover Tiziana Terenzi Casanova Anniversary Extrait de Parfum, a luxurious unisex fragrance inspired by the romance and mystery of Venice. This rich amber-woody scent blends floral, spicy, leathery and woody accords for an elegant, sensual and memorable finish.

  • Top Notes: Powdery Notes, Fig Leaf, Orchid, Bergamot, Jasmine
  • Heart Notes: Ambergris, Myrrh, Leather, Cardamom, Guaiac Wood, Pink Pepper, Vanilla
  • Base Notes: White Musk, Ambroxan, Cedar, Amber, Vetiver, Tonka Bean, Oakmoss

Tiziana Terenzi Chimaera Anniversary Extrait de Parfum 100ml is a rich and sophisticated unisex niche fragrance with spicy, woody, floral, and amber tones. Intense and distinctive, it offers excellent depth and long-lasting performance for lovers of luxury Italian perfumery.

A tonic parfum to invigorate mind and body, supporting physical endurance and exertion.

An elegant citrus-and-blossom scent inspired by the tenacity of sportsmanship and movement, to energise, stimulate and revitalise the mind body. It works for ,movement, and any kind of physical extension , to support mental endurance and movement center on the court on in the city.

A mindful parfum to support breathing, self-care and communication.

A scent inspired by the waterfalls and coastal landscapes to help support breathing and mindfulness. It supports breathing work and moments through the day when we need to be mindful and anchored, engage with our physical being and anchor.

Encased in a 10ml glass travel atomiser, you can easily pack it in your wash bag or carry-on. Choose the perfume that matches your mood and addresses your challenges while traveling.

A stimulating parfum designed to sharpen focus and awaken the senses.

Top: Cardamom, Elemi, Black Pepper, Green Pepper, Petitgrain

Middle: Nagarmotha, Ylang Ylang, Nutmeg

Base: Patchouli, Opoponax, Benzoin, Tonka, Sandalwood

Focus opens with sharp, spicy notes like cardamom and black pepper to invigorate. The middle layer combines earthy nagarmotha with floral ylang-ylang for balance, while the base of sandalwood and benzoin adds a warm, grounding finish. Designed for environments where mental clarity is essential.
